status: Designed — instrumentation and baseline required before launch
hypothesis: Showing approved operational trust signals at the first scan step will reduce uncertainty and increase the proportion of eligible scan sessions that complete the scan.
control: Current step 1 with no operational trust strip.
variant: Add a compact text-only trust strip below the step 1 introduction: 'PostNL is Vareya's main carrier within the Netherlands' | 'ShipHero WMS, fully integrated with Shopify' | '5-carrier network: PostNL, DHL, Asendia, FedEx and Royal Mail'. Do not use third-party logos.
unit_of_randomisation: Eligible browser assigned once and kept in a first-party cookie for the experiment
metric_definition: Unique eligible sessions with scan_complete / unique eligible sessions with scan_start; scan_start fires once when step 1 is rendered and scan_complete fires once only after a successful production submission.
baseline_status: Blocked — analytics helpers exist but are not wired into the scan UI.
baseline_value: N/A — 0 recorded production completions excluding QA; scan-start denominator is unavailable, so 0% must not be used.
baseline_window: Collect 14 consecutive days after event QA and before variant launch; keep funnel UX and acquisition mix stable.
baseline_data_quality: No reliable production start denominator; current code renders six steps while the brief describes five; original landing-page and UTM attribution can be lost on scan navigation.
secondary_metrics: Step 1→2 progression; per-step progression; completion rate by source page and device; submit success rate; qualified-lead rate as a diagnostic only.
guardrails: API/network error rate must not increase; no material deterioration in valid-lead rate; sample ratio must remain near 50/50; accessibility and mobile rendering must pass QA.
tracking_plan: GTM/GA4 events: experiment_exposure, scan_start, scan_step, scan_submit_attempt, scan_complete and scan_error. Attach experiment_id, variant, funnel_version, source_landing_page and device_category; never send PII or form answers. Persist experiment_id and variant with the lead for reconciliation. Configure GA4 custom dimensions and mark scan_complete as a key event.
analysis_segments: Source landing page; device; channel; new vs returning. Overall result is primary; segments are directional unless pre-powered.
exclusions: Staff and agency traffic; automated tests; bots/honeypot; duplicate events; test submissions; sessions without a valid assignment; traffic outside the six named source pages is reported separately.
minimum_run: At least 14 full days and complete weekly cycles; determine required sample from the measured baseline using α=0.05, 80% power and a 20% relative minimum detectable effect.
stopping_rule: Use a fixed sample determined before launch; do not stop early for apparent lift. Maximum 42 days; if the fixed sample is not reached, report inconclusive.
decision_rule: Ship the variant only if its two-sided 95% confidence interval for absolute lift excludes zero, relative lift is at least 10%, and guardrails pass. Otherwise keep control; label underpowered results inconclusive.
implementation_notes: Use only claims approved in content/claims-register.md. Establish and record the canonical funnel_version before baseline collection. Existing analytics helpers are defined but not wired into the scan UI, so instrumentation QA is a launch gate.
